subject: Workspace activation: roles, API key gating, and invite cadence

Subject: Workspace activation: roles, API key gating, and invite cadence

Hi Alex —

Great to kick off. Attached is a lightweight plan (org-roles-invite-plan.xlsx) that lays out the first two-week activation cadence: seeding a staging API key, creating an initial admin group, and rolling out invites in two waves. Two quick asks so we can finalize timeline:

1) Confirm the primary admin email we should seed as the first workspace owner (we have the trial contact listed as sam.patel@aventisretail.com).
2) Your preference for auth — do you want us to seed short-lived API keys now for staging while you finish the Okta SAML setup, or hold keys until SSO is enabled?

If agreeable, next steps on our side:
- We seed a staging key and create a "aventis-onboard-staging" project (scoped access, logging enabled).
- Monica will share the short playbook for seeding and rotation.
- Vivek will propose the initial role naming (admin/editor/viewer) and terraform mapping for later infra-as-code handoff.

Also included is a DocuSign link to the onboarding agreement; signing expedites access to Dedicated support for the first 30 days: https://www.docusign.com/embedded-sign/ABCDE12345 (stub).

Attaching: org-roles-invite-plan.xlsx

Thanks — I can run a 30-minute sync this week if you'd prefer to walk through the plan.

—Jordan

Jordan —

Thanks, appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers:
- Primary admin: Sam Patel (sam.patel@aventisretail.com) — confirmed.
- Auth preference: we prefer SSO (Okta) for prod. However, we do need a staging API key to run integration tests against your staging endpoint while our SSO team finalizes the SAML config. Please mark the staging key as non-prod and scope to a single project.

We have a SAML contact (julia.liu@aventisretail.com) who will be doing the assertion/metadata exchange; I'll include her on a separate thread if needed. For now, please go ahead with staging key seeding and the two-wave invite cadence.

Thanks Alex — perfect.

Plan update (we'll proceed as hybrid):
- Day 0 (today): seed a staging API key scoped to aventis-staging project, with strict token TTL and IP restrictions. Monica will send the seed instructions and rotation schedule.
- Day 1: create initial admin group (Sam + two backups). Please confirm the two backup admin emails; we suggest Sam + kate.wong@aventisretail.com + miguel.ramos@aventisretail.com if that works.
- Day 3: wave 1 invites (tech team), Day 7: wave 2 invites (product+ops).

I attached a short playbook for the staged invites (staged-invite-runbook.pdf) that shows the exact invite text and fallback policy.

Action items for you: confirm the two backup admins and whether we can create the project namespace now ("aventis-staging"). If you prefer to hold prod namespace creation until SSO is live, we can delay that.

I will also add the HubSpot deal link to the record for traceability: https://hubspot.example/deal/8451

—Jordan

Subject: Re: Workspace activation: roles, API key gating, and invite cadence

Alex / Jordan —

I'll own the seed/rotation steps. Summary of what we'll do and what we need from Aventis: 

1) Seeding (staging): we will generate one staging API key scoped to a new project namespace "aventis-staging" with the following default controls: token TTL = 24h, allowlist to your IP block (please confirm), and logging to your tenant's audit stream.
2) Rotation: we recommend 24h rotation for staging tests (short-lived tokens) and 30-day rotation for long-running non-prod CI tokens.
3) Production keys: we will only provision after SSO validation or an exception signed off by your security contact.

Please confirm: IP allowlist (CIDR) and the two backup admin emails Jordan proposed. Once confirmed I will post the seed instructions in the thread.

Attaching: api-key-seed-instructions.txt

Also, to speed security validation, please complete this short checklist: https://forms.gle/onboarding-security-checklist

—Monica
